title: Canonical projection formula for the tensor-unit action
statement: For any scheme Y and module-sheaf cochain complexes P,F, put O equal to the single tensor unit, V=Hom(P,O), and eta equal to the fixed K-injective augmentation. Suppose e:Tot(V tensor P) to O satisfies U(Hom(P,eta_O))=e;eta_O. Then the component of schemeTensorUnitAction(F,V,P,e);eta_F on (F^p tensor V^q) tensor P^r in degree k=n+r, n=p+q, is zero if r+q is nonzero; otherwise it is the component associator, F^p tensor the uncurried dual Hom projection identified with the tensor unit by singleObjXSelf, the right unitor, and XIsoOfEq from p to k, followed by eta_F in degree k. No ordinary evaluation map f or ordinary component predicate is used, and no existence of e is asserted.

proof.text: Apply schemeOrdinaryEvaluationGraded_augmentation to the coefficient augmentation eta_O. Taking degree components of the assumed factorization gives E_j;eta_O^j=e^j;eta_O^j. The standard K-injective augmentation is monic and evaluation preserves monomorphisms, so cancellation gives e^j=E_j for every j.

Restrict E_0 to the coproduct summand V^q tensor P^r for r+q=0. The mapBifunctorDesc summand equation gives the specified uncurried Hom projection. Postcompose with singleObjXSelf and apply tensorHomEquiv_comp_homObjMap and the inverse equivalence laws. This is proved with an arbitrary coefficient complex and an abstract projection morphism before specializing to the fixed projections, avoiding reduction of their large existence specification.

Unfold the tensor-unit action. Mathlib ι_mapBifunctorAssociatorX_hom and the two triple-inclusion equations take the triple summand to the component associator followed by the V,P inclusion. The ι_mapBifunctorMap equation inserts e. For r+q=0 the degree equations give p=k. Derive the right-unitor summand formula by postcomposing with its inverse, applying rightUnitor'_inv, and cancelling the single coefficient isomorphism and ordinary right unitor. Substitute the coefficient calculation of the preceding step. For r+q nonzero, isZero_single_obj_X makes the component of e zero, and additivity of tensoring makes the whole component zero. Finally postcompose with eta_F^k and use comp_f and associativity.

lean.statement:
theorem schemeCanonicalTensorUnit_component (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (e : pullbackTensorTotal Y
      (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
        ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
          (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) P ⟶
      (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
        (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))
    (p q r n k : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n) (hnr : n + r = k) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.isGrothendieckAbelian (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    let O := (HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
      (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))
    let V := homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P O
    let eta := CochainComplex.toKInjectiveResolution.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))
    let π := Classical.choose (homComplex_projections_exists.{u, u, u, u} (R := Y.sheaf))
    schemeTensorHomUncurry Y V P O
      (((homComplexFunctor (R := Y.sheaf)).obj (op P)).map (eta.app O)) =
        e ≫ eta.app O →
    (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F V (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n hpq ▷ P.X r)
      ≫ HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (pullbackTensorTotal Y F V) P
        (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) n r k hnr ≫
          (schemeTensorUnitAction Y F V P e ≫ eta.app F).f k =
    (if h : r + q = 0 then
      (α_ (F.X p) (V.X q) (P.X r)).hom ≫
        F.X p ◁ ((β_ (V.X q) (P.X r)).hom ≫
          (SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv (R := Y.sheaf) (P.X r) (V.X q)
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).symm
              (π P O q r 0 h ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := Y.sheaf) (𝟙 (P.X r))
                (HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (.up ℤ) 0
                  (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).hom)) ≫
        (ρ_ (F.X p)).hom ≫ (F.XIsoOfEq (by omega : p = k)).hom
    else 0) ≫ (eta.app F).f k
